# Remove-ZbxHostGroupMember

## SYNOPSIS

Removes hosts from a host group.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxHostGroupMember [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]> [-Group] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>> [-Force] [-PassThru] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Remove-ZbxHostGroupMember cmdlet takes the hosts given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped hosts) out of the host group in -Group with host.massremove, in one call when the pipeline ends; their other groups stay. A host must stay in at least one group, so the server refuses to remove its last. The command asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and writes the hosts only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Take a host out of a group

```powershell
Remove-ZbxHostGroupMember -InputObject 'web-01' -Group 'Web servers' -Confirm:$false
```

ConfirmImpact is High, so PowerShell asks first; -Confirm:$false answers for a script that has already decided.

### Example 2: Preview taking every host of a group out of it

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' | Remove-ZbxHostGroupMember -Group 'Linux servers' -WhatIf
```

-WhatIf names each host the command would change, and changes nothing.
